sources.title: Roadster Event — Tesla
sources.narration_safe_claim: Tesla 官方发布会包含斜坡/倒挂与空中翻滚演示，可说“官方演示中展示”。

sources.title: Tesla official: configurations
sources.narration_safe_claim: 官方配置说明区分主动空气动力/多模式吸附系统和后置冷气推进器，不能把两者画成同一种装置。
sources.quote:
Configurations

– Performance: road ready, seats 2

Active aerodynamics & multi-mode suction system for next-level performance on & off the track

– Thrust: race ready, seats 2

Multi-mode suction system paired w/ rear-mounted cold-gas thrusters that enable 0–60 in <1 second

– https://t.co/A3OQ3JqP0B

sources.title: Tesla unveils Cyberfied new Roadster that can kickflip
sources.narration_safe_claim: 报道将多模式吸附用于倒挂，将周向冷气推进器用于短距离地和旋转。
sources.quote: The suction system does the opposite job.
sources.limitations: 技术评论含作者推测和保留意见；勿复述其“打破物理定律”等修辞。飞行时长、整车质量、完整推力布置仍未核实。

sources.title: Are Tesla’s claims for its new ‘flying’ Roadster real, or is it just full of cold gas?

sources.title: Adaptive vehicle aerodynamics for downforce — US 12,377,920 B1
sources.narration_safe_claim: Tesla 专利描述可动裙边、多个风扇、不同路况模式和低压区域。
sources.quote: The system comprises multiple fans positioned in airflow pathways and deployable skirts that interact with the ground surface.
sources.limitations: 申请人 Tesla Inc.; 发明人 James Michael Arthur Crook, Christopher Ward, David Lemire; 申请日2025-04-29。专利证明方案被公开，不证明全部方案已用于演示车或量产车。

sources.title: WORLD FIRST: McMurtry Spéirling drives upside down from stationary
sources.narration_safe_claim: 可选一句历史对照：McMurtry 在2025年已展示风扇车从静止倒挂行驶。
sources.quote: Once fully inverted, Thomas drove forward, entirely unsupported.
sources.limitations: 这是 McMurtry Spéirling PURE VP1 的演示，不是 Tesla；若使用2000kg下压力需说约2000千克力/19.6kN而非质量。无需抢占本片主线。

sources.title: Newton’s Laws of Motion
sources.published: 2021-05-13 legacy NASA pages / current undated Newton page
sources.narration_safe_claim: 喷气把气体动量改变，车获得反向作用；合力控制质心加速度。
sources.quote: Whenever one object exerts a force on another object, the second object exerts an equal and opposite on the first.
sources.limitations: 公式用于教学简化，不是对 Tesla 私有设计的逆向识别。

sources.title: Rocket Thrust Equation
sources.published: 2021-05-13 legacy NASA pages / current undated Newton page
sources.narration_safe_claim: 推力由质量流率、喷气速度以及喷口压强项决定；本片冷气推进无燃烧，不可套用热火焰视觉。
sources.quote: F = m dot * Ve + (pe - p0) * Ae
sources.limitations: 公式用于教学简化，不是对 Tesla 私有设计的逆向识别。

sources.title: Torque (Moment)
sources.published: 2021-05-13 legacy NASA pages / current undated Newton page
sources.narration_safe_claim: 偏心作用力产生力矩；反向力矩用于降低角速度，转正不意味着自动停转。
sources.quote: If the object is unconfined and the force is applied at some distance from the center of gravity, the object both translates and rotates about the center of gravity.
sources.limitations: 公式用于教学简化，不是对 Tesla 私有设计的逆向识别。
